attempts.summary: Set up a cron-driven rsync-over-SSH sync (every 5 minutes, node2 pulling from node1) to keep /etc/inventory/app.conf synchronized, well within the 15-minute requirement. Verified end-to-end sync correctness both before and after restarting both nodes one at a time, confirming each node's boot identity changed and that services, cron schedule, and file checksums fully recovered.
